title: #5930 step 4 (`domain:engine`): the engine-fed faces delete their hand-copied filter meaning (driver-sql, turso remote, memory query, mongodb, formula, `having`); the memory reference matcher retires (D6)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task**, and a **④** child of #5930. The maintainer's words, verbatim: 「5930 v18 启动」. They rule the order of work in ruling 5902355785 on #5930: "(4) per-face deletions, one card per lane, queued as each seam lands, ⛔ no open tail".

Reader: the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01DEvba2nBuD4tWzfq8r8NFY`, `os-support-ai`), which claims it once it is queued. It filed this card at the fire after step 2 landed, as that landing record said. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why now

Step 2 (#5930, PR #20794, `cfa931535`) put `lowerFilterCondition` in `@objectstack/spec/data`. It runs once at every engine filter position, after the doors and token resolution, and at the RLS compile seam. The engine-fed faces now receive the lowered filter. Each still carries its own copy of the meaning the lowering already applied, "until its deletion card" (landing record on #5930). This is this lane's deletion card.

Not this card:
- the memory cube face (F5) and the analytics faces (F9, F10, F11) get their seam in step 3 (#20810), and their deletion cards follow it;
- the typed tree (T2) waits for the measurement the ruling names.

## Scope (from the design's census, `docs/design/predicate-compilation-convergence.md` §S5; re-measure first)

| Face | Deleted | Suites that hold it |
|:--|:--|:--|
| F1 `driver-sql` | the NULL-polarity quartet (67 lines), `assertDefinedComparands`, the `calendarDay*Rewrite` calls (5 sites) | `FILTER_LOGIC`, `FILTER_TEXT`, `TEMPORAL`, `FILTER_COMPARAND_TYPE` on SQLite, plus the PostgreSQL / MySQL live matrix |
| F2 `driver-turso` remote | `toRemoteFilter`'s `$between` / whole-day arms (3 sites), the transport's polarity copy (69 lines) | turso filter-logic (local and remote), local/remote NULL parity |
| F3 `driver-memory` query | whole-day calls (8 sites) | memory filter-logic, temporal, text |
| F4 `driver-memory` reference matcher | retired (ruling D6: no production caller) | its 20 importing test files move to the shared suites or to another oracle |
| F6 `driver-mongodb` | whole-day calls (4 sites) | mongodb filter-logic, text, temporal, comparand-type |
| F7 `formula` | `lteBound` (2 sites) | matches-filter not-null-safe, or-semantics, temporal |
| F8 objectql `having` | whole-day calls (4 sites) | having filter-logic, text, temporal |

Acceptance, per face:
- **Direct callers are measured first** (review 5903065983, open question 2: "one grep and one probe per step-4 card, no gate"). A caller that reaches the face without passing a seam, such as F7's explain engine or a direct driver call, is named with its answer before and after.
  - Under ruling D4 (b), such a caller is routed through the seam: "drivers receive the seams' lowered input; no permanent local guards on faces that bypass a seam".
  - If routing it changes an answer, that face stops and is reported.
- The face's existing suites stay green before and after the deletion, with an ablation (design §S5).
- ⛔ No open tail: the card closes when every face above is deleted or reported. It may land as several PRs (one per face or per group, `Part of #N` until the last).

Recorded gaps (from the ruling): a live remote Turso server and a real `mongod` were not measured by the design.

- 「#5930 step 4 deletion card engine lane faces receive lowered filter retire memory reference matcher」: 21 hits. #20810 (open) is step 3, the analytics seams. #20734 (open) is F5's door finding, in #20810's scope. #5930 is the umbrella. None is step 4.
